title: Sign in to AdviseCare
subtitle: Use the email address or username and password associated with your university account.
passwordHint: Your credentials are sent only to the AdviseCare API over the configured server connection.
invalidCredentials: The email/username or password is incorrect.
accountUnavailable: This account is inactive or access is unavailable. Contact your system administrator.
conflictError: This request conflicts with the current account state.
requestError: The request could not be completed.
networkError: The AdviseCare API is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
notFound: The requested sign-in resource could not be found.
expiredSession: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
logoutUnconfirmed: Your local session was cleared, but the API could not confirm remote sign-out.
accessDenied: Your account does not have permission to open this workspace.
forgotSubtitle: Enter your account email. If it is linked and active, the API will send a one-time reset link.
resetSubmitted: If the account is eligible, a password reset email has been sent.
resetFailed: The password reset request could not be completed.
roleStudentCaption: Personal record, consent matrix, access history
roleHeadCaption: Cohort analytics, advisor workload, assignment approvals
noticeBody: The API checks your account status, session and role on each protected request. Student data values are returned only through the backend access guard.
legalLine: AdviseCare records access and consent decisions according to the institutional data-protection workflow.
